body:
@Haroenv

We are using NextJS with SSR and ran into this issue when implementing `useRefinementList`. To improve our SEO, we want to render links for each filter (but default to client side navigation once JS loads). We are blocked because `createURL` only runs on the client.

> This is a complicated edge case, a bit of a chicken-and-egg problem.
>
> 1. createURL called by the widget is createURL called by the connector
> 2. the result of createURL depends on what the current UI state + mounted widgets is
> 3. when you call createURL, in an initial render (like on server side rendering) the widgets aren't yet mounted

Is this actually a limitation when running `InstantSearchSSRProvider` ([docs](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/ssr-provider/react-hooks/))?

I'm running `getServerState` ([docs](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/server-state/react-hooks/)) in `getServerSideProps` *before* SSR begins. At this point, we don't care if `createURL` returns nothing. At the next stage, we begin SSR knowing the UI state. Why can't `createURL` know the correct URL?
